evidenceType: observed x86-64 entry bytes plus stored ProcessAlg call site

observations: RCX, RDX and R9 are spilled into the home/stack area before nonvolatile saves.
R14 receives R9, R13 receives R8, R15 receives RDX, RSI receives RCX.
The observed mapping is consistent with RCX=this, RDX=module input, R8=ROI/mask collection, R9=additional region state from the ProcessAlg call site.
The call site also supplies a fifth stack argument represented by the decompiler as stack flags.
